Campaign name
- See Your Brilliance with Glint Eyewear

Unique Selling Proposition (USP)
- Glint Eyewear delivers prescription-ready, fashion-forward eyewear with precision optics and smart lens options (blue light, photochromic/transition, polarized), enhanced by seamless virtual try-on and home-fit convenience. Emotional hook and core campaign message
- Hook: When you can see clearly and look unmistakably stylish, you move through the world with confidence and charisma.
- Core message: See your best. Shine your brightest. Glint Eyewear makes sharp vision and bold fashion effortless, so every moment feels intentional.

Target audience and positioning
- Primary audiences
  - Style-forward adults (ages 22–40) who value fashion, self-expression, and tech-enabled shopping.
  - Professionals and remote workers who wear glasses all day and want comfort, durability, and optimized lenses (blue light, transitions).
- Secondary audiences
  - Sunglasses lovers with prescription needs and outdoor enthusiasts seeking polarized or photochromic lenses.
- Positioning statement
  - Glint Eyewear is the premium-accessible eyewear brand that marries runway-ready designs with ophthalmic-grade optics, hassle-free buying (virtual try-on, at-home fit), and thoughtful lens options to elevate every moment you live in.

Brand tone and visual identity
- Tone: Confident, optimistic, slightly playful, polished, authentic.
- Visual identity: Clean, contemporary, high-contrast photography; bold frame silhouettes; subtle glint/reflection motif in gold or chrome; lifestyle moments that feel aspirational but attainable; color palette—monochrome neutrals with accent glints (amber/gold/ice blue).
- Consistency across channels: use the same typefaces, logo lockups, and the “glint” visual cue in all assets; maintain a minimalist layout with high-contrast imagery to emphasize lenses and frames.

Campaign pillars (message pillars)
- Pillar 1: Vision you can feel
  - Emphasize optics quality, precise prescriptions, and lens options.
- Pillar 2: Fashion that speaks
  - Highlight frame design, materials, and brand personality.
- Pillar 3: Effortless, modern shopping
  - Focus on virtual try-on, home try-on, fast fulfillment, and seamless returns.

- Objective: Showcase authentic veggie-forward experiences in Lisbon (restaurants, markets, neighborhood strolls).
